P.text: A cross-chain message arrives via LayerZero to mint tokens to a recipient on the Spoke chain (MegaETH), and the recipient address is blacklisted.
P.evidence_quote: When a cross-chain message arrives via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user

I.text: The minting path should not revert for a blacklisted recipient in a way that leaves the LayerZero message permanently unexecutable, since LayerZero v2 nonces are strictly ordered and subsequent messages cannot be processed until the failed message succeeds.
I.evidence_quote: In LayerZero v2, if the execution of a message reverts, the message is considered "failed" but the nonce is still strictly ordered. Subsequent messages with higher nonces cannot be processed until the failed message is successfully executed.

V.text: The `_beforeTokenTransfer` hook reverts with `OperationNotAllowed` when the recipient is blacklisted, causing `lzReceive` to revert; because the user remains blacklisted the message will never succeed (unless the admin un-blacklists the user), permanently blocking the cross-chain channel.
V.evidence_quote: If the recipient is blacklisted, `_beforeTokenTransfer` reverts with `OperationNotAllowed`.
